properties.name: vadmin.local-iam.enabled
properties.description: Enables the built-in local IAM. System administration follows this value unless vadmin.system-admin.enabled is set explicitly. Set to false when the host provides identity and authorization beans.

properties.name: vadmin.system-admin.enabled
properties.description: Enables the shared Users, Roles, Permissions and Audit pages. Defaults to vadmin.local-iam.enabled. Hosts may enable this with their own AdministrationStore and AccessControlRepository.

properties.name: vadmin.local-iam.table-prefix
properties.description: Prefix for the six local IAM tables. The default vadmin becomes the physical prefix vadmin_. A blank value is rejected and does not fall back to unprefixed names. Flyway V2 renames the original tables once; the prefix is then frozen, while constraint and index names stay unchanged.
